seen.where: LASA A 1 Nr. 530: https://recherche.landesarchiv.sachsen-anhalt.de/Query/detail.aspx?ID=80463, images via METS https://recherche.landesarchiv.sachsen-anhalt.de/xslt/index.aspx?xml=A_1__Nr_530-producer.xml (DFG viewer); frames 3, 8, 13 opened full size, 9-11 at reduced size, frames 1-154 on contact sheets
seen.extent: 307 images in all. Frames 8-11 (ff. 5-7, headed '1647. ad Diarium No. 31' and 'No. 32'): about 40 lines, mostly cipher on f.6, several lines on f.5, more on f.7. Frames 155-307 not looked at, so the total in the volume is not counted.
seen.cipher: German clear text interrupted by long runs of letter cipher with signs inside them, e.g. on f.5 'hsdibgurgold sdked bqusdrsdt'. Latin letters as ciphertext, no numbers. Nothing is written between the lines or beside the runs on f.5, and none is visible on ff.6-7, so no decipherment on or with these leaves.
